requirement_text.REQ-425:
MOB-6 in docs/mobile/requirements.md (build-order M6; depends on M2). Built BEFORE MOB-4 (REQ-426..428) -- see the S9 header: the renderers' six states classify this requirement's ApiError. SECURITY-REVIEWER gate (refresh-token handling, token clearing).

Hardens lib/api/api_client.dart (created by REQ-421) into the single client:
1. Attach the active tenant's bearer token (REQ-422's iss check).
2. On 401: exactly one silent refresh via flutter_appauth's token refresh, then exactly one retry of the original request; concurrent 401s share one in-flight refresh. On refresh failure: clear the tenant's tokens (REQ-422 store) and route to login.
3. Exponential backoff on 5xx for idempotent methods only (GET), bounded attempts; POST is not auto-retried (no duplicate task completion).
4. Normalise every failure to a sealed ApiError type before it leaves lib/api/: at minimum network-unavailable, unauthorized, forbidden (403), not-found, module-not-available (a 404 on any /api/v1/modules/<id>/ path -- architecture.md §6: absence is 404, not 403, and must not render as a generic not-found), backpressure (429, carrying the Retry-After seconds -- the backend emits 429 from lib/letflow/plugs/admission.ex and lib/letflow/plugs/public_read_rate_limit.ex), validation (422 with RFC 9457 field errors), conflict (409), server (5xx after retries).
5. A static guard (apps/mobile/test/guards/), the counterpart of the SPA's raw-fetch-outside-client guard in web/tests/guards/: no file outside lib/api/ imports package:dio or package:http or uses dart:io HttpClient; with a self-test.

task.description:
Step 2b-mobile of WF-02 for REQ-425. Implement lib/letflow/design/req425-mobile-api-client-hardening.md in full -- it went through 3 rework cycles with CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR and is now PASSed; read it in full (all 10 sections) before writing any code, it is the authoritative spec for every function signature, the ApiError variant list, the status-code mapping rule, the module-path regex, the refresh-coordinator sequence, the backoff formula and named constant, and the guard's scan/self-test design. Do not invent a different shape than what the design states.

Key implementation points to get right (the design's own emphasis, not a substitute for reading it): (1) Sec 5.2's AppAuthAdapter.refresh contract was verified against the REAL pinned flutter_appauth 12.1.0 API (FlutterAppAuth.token(TokenRequest) -> Future<TokenResponse>, grantType auto-inferred to refresh_token when refreshToken is set) -- re-confirm this against apps/mobile/pubspec.lock before implementing, in case the pin has moved. (2) Sec 2.1/2.2's _RefreshCoordinator must genuinely coalesce concurrent 401s into one shared in-flight Future -- this is AC1's exact test target. (3) Sec 2.6 states the test-inspection seam: ApiClient.forTesting now takes required tokenStore/activeRealm parameters (matching .create) so AC1/AC2's tests can wire a real TenantTokenStore backed by the existing FakeSecureStoragePlatform. (4) Sec 3's kMaxServerRetryAttempts constant and exact backoff formula must be implemented with an injectable delay function for fake-clock testability -- do not hardcode Future.delayed with a real Duration in a way a test cannot control. (5) Sec 4's static guard goes in apps/mobile/test/guards/ (the design specifies its scan scope and self-test fixture design in Sec 4.1-4.2 as prose, not code -- you write the actual Dart). (6) Sec 1.3's module-path regex for the module-404-vs-plain-404 distinction must match exactly.

Work per your role's standard procedure: verify branch (feature/WF02-REQ425-20260929, already checked out), implement in apps/mobile/ ONLY (no web/ or lib/ changes -- a backend gap goes to ORCH for ELIXIR-DEV routing, a shared-contract question goes back to CODE-DESIGNER), run `flutter analyze && flutter test` from apps/mobile/ quoting real output, self-review against your role file's tier constraints (one tenant-agnostic build, no general scripting runtime on-device, tokens in OS-secure storage only). If flutter_appauth's real API differs from what Sec 5.2 states (OQ-2 in the design flags this as verified-but-reconfirm), report the actual mismatch rather than silently adapting around it -- that would be a design deviation worth flagging to ORCH/CODE-DESIGNER, not a silent judgment call.

Write the test code too (per WF-02 Step 2b-mobile's note: Dart tests under apps/mobile/test/ are written by MOBILE-DEV in this step, same as TEST-DESIGNER writes ExUnit tests for backend -- TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR still review them against the acceptance criteria in the next steps, so write real, complete tests now, not stubs).

Complete the handoff: artifacts_out: [every file actually created/changed in apps/mobile/lib/api/ and apps/mobile/test/], next_action: "Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER (2c) -- this touches auth/token refresh/token clearing (MOB-6), in scope per security-reviewer.md's token-handling clause".
acceptance_criteria: a test where the fake server returns 401 once then 200 asserts exactly one refresh call and exactly one retry, and that two concurrent requests both receiving 401 trigger one refresh total
a test where refresh fails asserts the tenant's tokens are deleted from the secure store and the router is at the login route

a test asserts a GET receiving 503 twice then 200 succeeds with increasing delays between attempts (fake clock), a GET receiving 503 on every attempt stops after the maximum attempt count declared as a named constant in lib/api/ and surfaces ApiError server (the test asserts the exact number of requests sent), and a POST receiving 503 is not retried

a test per ApiError variant asserts the mapping from status code/exception, including 404 on /api/v1/modules/exam/x -> module-not-available, 404 elsewhere -> not-found, and 429 with 'Retry-After: 7' -> backpressure(7 seconds)
a test asserts no DioException or SocketException escapes lib/api/ -- the public client API returns or throws only ApiError
the single-client guard fails its self-test fixture (a file under lib/features/ importing package:dio) and passes on the real tree
cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze && flutter test pass, real output quoted, and SECURITY-REVIEWER signs off before merge
